question_stem:
A $\beta^-$ particle from a radioactive source is travelling in a vacuum with kinetic energy $460\text{ eV}$. The particle enters a uniform electric field at a right-angle and follows the path shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: The direction of the electric field is in the plane of the paper. On Fig. 7.1, draw an arrow to show the direction of the electric field.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Calculate the speed of the $\beta^-$ particle before it enters the electric field.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Other $\beta^-$ particles from the same radioactive source travel outside the electric field along the same incident path as that shown in Fig. 7.1.

State and briefly explain whether those $\beta^-$ particles will all follow the same path inside the electric field.
